WHAT THE FIRST SCREEN IS NOW (staff, Starbucks test brand, 1440x900)
- Header line (the company page's own line): logo, name, category, then badges: rollout, Hunter pick, covenant grade (as the phone), one KYC chip that jumps to Company checks, and for staff one amber "Core facts need review" chip that opens the review. Right side: Pitch property (the one filled button), Add to deal, Email, Call (only with a phone number), Brand pack, Brand case (Landsec view, as today), More.
- ONE More menu with text labels: Edit brand facts, Edit company record, Refresh profile, Change website (reads Add / Confirm website when unconfirmed), Review saved facts (when flagged), Find stock ticker (when none), Profile status and sources, Delete company. The website editor, fact review, ticker picker and preparation details open in a dialog. The page's own Edit and Delete buttons are hidden on a brand (they are in More); every other company kind keeps them.
- Summary band (one card, two columns): left = About (three lines, Show more opens full text, source notes, backers with Create, department store and franchise notes, stock card; opened text takes the full card width), a line of facts and links (industry, reported stores, HQ, website, LinkedIn, Instagram/TikTok with followers, listing, backers, Part of), and "What they sell" (first four menu items, "Show all N" jumps to the full card, found by test id so it still lands after the card moves). Right = "Working with BGP" as figures (last touch, CRM contacts, email threads, live deals, completed deals, requirements, active in 90 days), BGP team line (Show team opens the role cards; Set/Edit team), then one counted line each for Tenant at / Targeted / Pitched / Suggested pitches with "Show all N" opening the existing rows.
- Brand conversation: compact mode. Empty = title, hint, chips in two rows, input: 188px. With messages it takes the band's height and scrolls inside (capped at 24rem), with an Expand button.
- Group entities KYC card: out of the top, now at the end of the fifth section (data-testid="brand-group-entities"), as instructed for now.
- Pill row directly under the top and sticky (it now really sticks: the company page wrapper was a scroll box that defeated sticky; brand pages use overflow-x-clip).
- Measured: Starbucks staff band 181 to 467px, pills at 471, first pill content (brand-overview-cards) starts at 531. Thin brand (Testco Bakery): pills 342, content 403. Client login Starbucks: pills 440, content 501. At 1180 and 1024 wide the conversation stacks under the band and content still starts at 773 / 812.

CLIENT LOGIN: sees the same facts as today (last touch from its visible contacts, live/completed/requirement counts, team, Tenant at etc. lists, website, details), laid out in the band. Staff-only: contacts figure, email threads figure, core facts chip, "No KYC" chip (a client sees a KYC chip only when a state is recorded, the same wording its Company checks card shows), editing controls, and live tenancies folded into the Tenant at line. No server data was added; no server change except the app map.

OTHER SCREENS: landlord pages (Hammerson, Landsec) looked at and unchanged, Edit/Delete still on the page. The deal page's Brand Profiles card (non-flat mount) was opened and still shows the old layout. Agent and lender branches not touched.

KEPT FOR THE MERGE: data-testid="brand-overview-cards" is untouched and still the first cards of Overview; phone file not touched. Existing test ids kept (button-brand-refresh, button-brand-edit, button-edit-company, button-delete-company, button-brand-pack, button-brand-case, link-phone, link-linkedin, button-about-more, button-brand-contacts-count, button-brand-emails, brand-profile-card, brand-conversation, brand-working-with-bgp, brand-factual-summary, brand-relationship-line, brand-fact-review-toggle, the five brand-section-* pills). DATABASE (shared bgpsmoke), all listed: (1) Starbucks 11110000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201, NULL fields filled with COALESCE: description, industry, phone, linkedin_url, rollout_status, backers, instagram_handle, tiktok_handle, dept_store_presence, franchise_activity, founded_year, menu_intel (8 items), menu_intel_at. WHAT A BRAND'S "DEALS & SPACE" PILL NOW SHOWS
- Deals card (new): the 20 most recent deals the brand is a party to. Each row has the deal name (opens the deal), Ref # and type, the brand's role, property (opens the property) and unit, a stage chip and the last update. The title carries the total; the line under it gives live and completed. It shows 8, then "Show all"; with more than 20 it says "The 20 most recent of N". Staff get "Open in Deals". A wide card is a table; a narrow one is a card list.
- Viewings card, under Deals: upcoming and attended in 90 days, each with outcome, next action and follow-up date (amber once passed). Shows 4, then "Show all".
- Beside them: Live tenancies, Lease events and Space preferences in one card; BGP requirements and PIPnet in another. Titles now match and each list has a cap with "Show all N".
- Empty cards are not drawn. Staff get one quiet line each with the action that fills it; a client login gets nothing. The "none on PIPnet" filler is gone for clients.
- The pill count is now every deal the brand is a party to, the same number as the card title.

WHO SEES WHICH DEALS
- It is not the landlord deals board, so ordinary lettings where the brand is only the tenant are included and sister brands are not.
- A client login gets only deals where its own company is landlord, vendor or purchaser. This is the same rule the profile's existing deal data uses, and the counts follow it.
- A Landsec asset manager gets only deals at their own schemes. If the schemes cannot be worked out, the list is empty.
- No fee, fee split or BGP team is sent to anyone from this list.

Step 5 (one card pattern and the phone) is built in /home/user/bgp-brandpage. Typecheck passes. Nothing committed.

HOW IT WAS CHECKED
I did not build or start the app. I drew the real desktop panel and the real phone view in a test browser environment, reading from the local app already running on port 5104 (reads only; every write was refused), then laid the result out in Chromium with the app's stylesheet at 1440, 1100 and 390 wide. Seen this way: Starbucks and Testco Bakery as staff and as the Landsec client, on desktop and phone; Hammerson (landlord) on desktop and phone; the deal page's brand card on desktop and the deal's Brand tab on the phone. This is not the same as clicking through the running app. The running local server predates the deal list and no local brand has mapped stores, so the deals card and the stores board were seen with sample rows fed in.

DESKTOP: CARDS BROUGHT TO THE PATTERN
- CRM plan (Overview): small uppercase title, "Add CRM action" and "Open full plan" as text links, only the blocks that hold something (CRM actions, Events, Active strategies, each counted), "Show all N". A plan with nothing in it is no longer a card: one line, "No CRM actions, events or strategies yet · Add CRM action · Open full plan". A client login's card is titled "Your requests to BGP"; with nothing open it is one line with "Add a request for BGP" (the client keeps its way to raise a request).
- BGP take: same small uppercase title as the other cards.
- Stores: title with the UK store count, summary line, "Refresh stores" as a text link. With no UK store mapped there is no card: staff read "UK stores not mapped yet · 257 reported in total · Refresh stores".
- Menu highlights / Best sellers: title with the item count, "Looked up 12 Nov · Source", first 8 items then "Show all N" (no scroll box), Refresh as a text link. Alone on the row it takes the width in two columns. Staff with no items read "No menu items yet · Refresh"; clients still see it only when it has items. Still mounted once.
- Leftovers removed: "News & social" printed straight over "News & media" when only the news side has content; "No UK stores mapped" shown to a client above a full menu card; Tenant rep rows are now about 30px each instead of 45px.

PHONE (client/src/components/mobile-brand-view.tsx)
- A brand's own page has the same six pills, same names, same order: Overview, Deals & space, Stores & menu, Expansion, People & checks, News & media.
- Overview: About, BGP take, Open conversation, CRM plan (the brand LandlordEngagementPanel line is untouched), the phone-only "BGP engagement" card, then the website line and Refresh images.

People & checks: Represented by, Key contacts, then the combined Company checks card (the old Covenant and Compliance cards are gone from a brand's page). News & media: one News & social card (stories already under Signals left out), then the Instagram handle (the "@@handle" double sign is fixed).

- Empty boxes removed on the brand page: an all-noughts BGP engagement card, "Website not found yet" for a client, an Expansion card with only a heading.
- Landlord, agent and lender pages on the phone, and the Brand tab inside a deal, keep their older pills and behaviour (a client there still opens on Contacts).

NO NEW INFORMATION TO CLIENT LOGINS: no server change in this step except the app map. Everything a client sees on the phone was already on its phone page, or is the deals list that step 3 limited on the server.

TESTS: qa/regression/phone-property-brand.test.mjs updated (it pinned the old "client opens on Contacts" rule) and extended: 8 pass. 22 other test files that read these components: all pass except the three failures earlier steps reported (two landlord page tests, one that needs a database). server/chat-app-guide.test.ts and server/brand-profile-deals.test.ts: 45 pass.
